services.desc: Get ready for a one-of-a-kind fishing trip with Croix Boys Guided Adventures! Our 4-hour Sturgeon excursion is perfect for anglers looking to land the big one while enjoying some serious comfort. We're talking a party barge with indoor seating, heat, and a bathroom - no roughing it here, folks. Whether you're a seasoned sturgeon chaser or just looking for a fun day on the water, this trip's got you covered. Here's the scoop: You'll be cruising on our decked-out party barge for four solid hours of sturgeon fishing.
